newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Light Nigerian plane crashes, kills five.
newsitem.headline: Light Nigerian plane crashes, kills five.

text.p: A light aircraft belonging to a Nigerian airline crashed on landing in the northeast town of Yola on Friday, killing five people, witnesses said.
"Visibility was poor and the plane hovered around Yola for some time before attempting to land and it crashed a few metres to the airport," said one journalist at the site.
He said five people died but did not know if they included the crew of the plane belonging to an air charter operator known as Skypower.
The 16-seater plane was on a chartered flight to Yola for the central bank and had 14 passengers on board, the journalist said.

Navy Captain Joe Igbomaoh, the military administrator of Adamawa state of which Yola is the capital, had visited the scene as well as the Yola specialist hospital where several people injured in the crash were being treated.
Nigeria has a poor air safety record. In the latest major crash a Boeing 727 came down into a lagoon near Lagos last November, killing all 142 people on board.
